definitions.gloss: to add, to append, to supplement
definitions.explanation: To include additional information, items, or elements to something already existing.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧{付|つ}け{加|くわ}える。
examples.english: Let me add one more word.

examples.japanese: ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{具体例|ぐたいれい}→具体例：14760_gutairei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}け{加|くわ}えた。
examples.english: I added concrete examples to the explanation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧{付|つ}け{加|くわ}えさせて⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: Allow me to add just one more thing at the end.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to attach) + ⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧ (to add). Means to supplement or append something to what already exists.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the thing being added

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧{付|つ}け{加|くわ}える: to add a word/remark
- ⟦{補足|ほそく}→補足：08386_hosoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}け{加|くわ}える: to add a supplement
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}け{加|くわ}える: to add information
- ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}け{加|くわ}える: to add a condition
- ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}け{加|くわ}える: to add an explanation

USAGE:
Commonly used in speeches, meetings, and writing when supplementing a point. The polite form {付|つ}け{加|くわ}えさせて⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧ (allow me to add) is standard in formal settings.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧: to add (simpler, broader)
- ⟦{追加|ついか}する→追加する：19646_tsuikasuru⟧: to add, to append (more formal, often for data/items)
